## Features
- Built-in powerful air blower automatically inflates decorations
- Super bright LED lights let inflatable decoration light up your yard
- Zipper design for quick deflation

## Information
Create a Christmas wonderland with this inflatable Santa snow globe!This Christmas decoration consists of Santa, snowman and road sign, which will create a festive focal point in your yard, lawn, party. This lighted yard decoration features 3 bright LED lights for a glowing, lighting effect. This playful blow-up decoration is designed for durability with its premium polyester material. To make it an easy piece for you to set up and break down for storage, this lighted Christmas decoration comes with powerful blower for quick inflation and a storage bag for easy storage. You can put the water bags inside the inflatable, and attach the ropes and insert the ground stakes to increase stability.
